pillars: Local Sri Lankan Tech Policy & Regulatory Updates

plays.title: TechTalk 360 Authority Building
plays.description: Clip and share insights from Sri Lanka's #1 tech podcast to grow listeners and cement host authority.
plays.action:
1. Publish or finish a TechTalk 360 episode.
2. Extract 1-2 key quotes or actionable takeaways that resonate with local tech audience.
3. Post on X with a short lead-in and link to https://techtalk360.lk.
4. Use #lka and engage with every reply.
5. Repeat on a consistent weekly cadence.

plays.title: Ambassador Tool Drops
plays.description: Drive tool adoption with ultra-short, high-energy posts that highlight Cursor or ElevenLabs using your regional lead status.
plays.action:
1. Have a real win or new discovery with Cursor (or ElevenLabs).
2. Open with a proven hook like "RUN!" or "Finally!".
3. Immediately follow with the direct link (App Store or product page).
4. Optionally add "Cursor Ambassador & Regional Lead South Asia" for credibility.
5. Post and reply to early engagers.

plays.title: Local Policy & VAT Explainers
plays.description: Turn complex Sri Lankan tech tax, billing, and infrastructure announcements into crystal-clear action lists that local developers and businesses need.
plays.action:
1. Track official updates from AWS, banks (e.g. Sampath, Visa), airlines or regulators.
2. Break it down starting with "[Topic] Update – Key Points".
3. List precise next steps (e.g. "AWS Billing Console → Tax Settings. Enter your Sri Lanka VAT Tax Registration Number (TRN).").
4. Note deadlines and add #lka #tax.
5. Post and invite questions for follow-ups.

plays.title: Direct Callouts & Manifesting
plays.description: Build reach and conversation by directly addressing local companies on issues and posting short aspirational statements about AI and tech progress.
plays.action:
1. Notice a concrete local service problem or personal tech excitement (e.g. airlines, next Cursor feature).
2. For issues: "Sri Lankan Airlines, Are you aware about this?" + cc relevant people + #srilanka #lka.
3. For momentum: "Always on top! Manifesting the next Composer." or "Finally!" + context + hashtags.
4. Keep copy extremely short.
5. Post when the feeling or observation is fresh.
